title: Branch Guard configuration
description: Declares branch roles for one repository so the guard skill, the command hook, and the audit script all read the same one-way integration policy. Keep the file flat: string arrays and string scalars only, and avoid double quotes or backslashes inside branch names so shell-only consumers can parse it.

production.description: Branch names or glob patterns that act as production/release sources.

integration.description: Shared validation branch names or glob patterns. These are one-way collection pools and must never flow back into work or production branches.

workPatterns.description: Glob patterns for scoped work branches. Branches that match neither production nor integration are treated as work branches even without a match here.

promotionPaths.description: Explicitly allowed environment promotions, written as "source->target", for example "dev->test".

enforcement.description: How the command hook reacts to a forbidden flow: deny blocks it, ask defers to the user, warn allows it with a warning.
